book.name: 2 TESALONICENSES
book.title: U KAꞌBꞌ Uꞌ ITZꞌIBꞌA BꞌEN U PABLO XEꞌ QꞌU NIMAN TETZ U JESUUSTU TESALOONICA Ikaꞌv uꞌuj uvaꞌ itzꞌibꞌa bꞌen u Pablo te unqꞌa aa Tesalónica uvaꞌ ni niman u Jesús

content: U tulebꞌal u Jesucristo as tukꞌ u tulebꞌal u vibꞌooqꞌol unqꞌa bꞌanol vaꞌlexh
As la val sete, vitzꞌin vatzik, tiꞌ u tulebꞌal u Kubꞌaal Jesucristo as tiꞌ kukꞌulat veꞌt qibꞌ tukꞌ Aak. As la val sete,

tiꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ la ejalpu etxumbꞌal taꞌn umaꞌtoj chusbꞌal uvaꞌ la alpu sete tiꞌ uvaꞌ kat ilejlu veꞌt u qꞌiieꞌ uvaꞌ alel kan tiꞌ u tulebꞌal u Kubꞌaaleꞌ vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ unpajte. As sotziꞌk ekꞌuꞌl staꞌn. As kꞌuxh la ul tal umaj uxhchil uvaꞌ aꞌ u Tiixhla Espíritu ni alon, as moj in ni alon, as moj in ni tzꞌibꞌan u yoleꞌ sete chaj la taleꞌ,

as etaqꞌak etibꞌ maxtibꞌeloj te u uxhchileꞌ. As vaꞌlexh kuxh veꞌt itxumbꞌal unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ la ibꞌaneꞌ tiꞌ teesal iqꞌii u Tiixheꞌ. As aꞌn la ul ikꞌuch veꞌt tibꞌ u najeꞌ uvaꞌ ibꞌooqꞌol unqꞌa bꞌanol vaꞌlexheꞌ uvaꞌ alel veꞌt kan stiꞌ uvaꞌ la bꞌen tu kꞌaxkꞌo,
tan la ul teesa naj iqꞌii unqꞌa veeꞌ skajayil uvaꞌ tiixh vatz unqꞌa tenameꞌ as tukꞌ unqꞌa veeꞌ ninach unqꞌa tenameꞌ sivaatzil u Tiixheꞌ. As naj la ul toksa veꞌt tibꞌ tiixhil vatz unqꞌa tenameꞌ.
As la etulsa sekꞌuꞌl uvaꞌ kat val kan sete tul uvaꞌ atik in sexoꞌl.
As ootzimaleꞌ setaꞌn abꞌil uveꞌ ni majon ivatz u tulebꞌal vibꞌooqꞌol unqꞌa bꞌanol vaꞌlexheꞌ. Estiꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ lanal ilej veꞌt iqꞌii as aꞌn la ul veꞌteꞌ,
tan niyakꞌin veꞌt u vaꞌlexhla txumbꞌaleꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ ootzimalik sqaꞌn sbꞌaxa. Pet lanal eesal el umaꞌl uvaꞌ xoꞌl unqꞌa tenameꞌ u vaaꞌ ni majon ivatz ibꞌooqꞌol unqꞌa bꞌanol vaꞌlexheꞌ.
As aꞌn la ikꞌuch veꞌt tibꞌ u bꞌanol vaꞌlexheꞌ. As aꞌ veꞌt u Kubꞌaaleꞌ la yatzꞌon naj tukꞌ umaꞌl u yol uvaꞌ la tal Aak. As la sotzsal naj taꞌn vilitzꞌkabꞌan Aakeꞌ tul la ul Aak unpajte.

As u bꞌanol vaꞌlexheꞌ tan la ul ikꞌuch tibꞌ naj tukꞌ u tijleꞌm u Satanás. As nim talchu naj la ibꞌaneꞌ, as la ibꞌan naj umaj u kꞌuchbꞌal tetz u tijleꞌmeꞌ uvaꞌ la teqꞌo taama unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ staꞌn. As chulin yol kuxh naj la ibꞌaneꞌ.
As tukꞌ vitxumbꞌaleꞌ uvaꞌ vaꞌlexh kuxhtuꞌ la imaxtibꞌekat unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ la bꞌen tu kꞌaxkꞌoeꞌ, tan tiꞌ uvaꞌ kat tixva unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ u jikla yoleꞌ uvaꞌ la qꞌalpun.
Estiꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ la taqꞌ tzan u Tiixheꞌ umaꞌl u txumbꞌal uvaꞌ xoꞌvebꞌal chittuꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa tenameꞌ. As la maxtibꞌel unqꞌa tenameꞌ staꞌn, tan aꞌ veꞌt u chuli yoleꞌ la inima unqꞌa tenameꞌ.
Estiꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ ech ibꞌen veꞌt unqꞌa tenameꞌ tu u kꞌaxkꞌoeꞌ, jankꞌal uvaꞌ yeꞌ kat niman u jikla yoleꞌ. Pet aal kat chiibꞌ tiꞌ ibꞌanat u vaꞌlexheꞌ.
Ni taqꞌ u Pablo taꞌntiixh te u Tiixh tiꞌ uvaꞌ kat itxaa Aak unqꞌa aa Tesalónica tiꞌ isotz ipaav

Pet ech koj oꞌ, vitzꞌin vatzik, tan aal la qaqꞌ taꞌntiixh te u Tiixheꞌ setiꞌ bꞌenameen, ex uvaꞌ xoꞌn ex te u Kubꞌaaleꞌ, tan tiꞌ uvaꞌ kat itxaa ex Aak xeꞌ qꞌiisaj tiꞌ eqꞌalpul vatz vepaaveꞌ tul kat ekꞌujbꞌaꞌ ekꞌuꞌl tiꞌ u jikla yoleꞌ. As tukꞌ u Tiixhla Espíritu kat itxaakat ex Aak
tiꞌ isotzsal epaav tul kat qal u bꞌaꞌnla yoleꞌ sete tiꞌ uvaꞌ la oksal eqꞌii echeꞌ toksal iqꞌii u Kubꞌaal Jesucristo.
Estiꞌeꞌ ni val sete, vitzꞌin vatzik, echabꞌataj ekꞌujbꞌaꞌt ekꞌuꞌl. As yeꞌ la eyaꞌsa enimat unqꞌa chusbꞌaleꞌ uvaꞌ kat kuchus kan sete, as moj unqꞌa yoleꞌ uvaꞌ kat kutzꞌibꞌa bꞌen sete, as enimataj.

Tan xoꞌn chit oꞌ te u Kubꞌaal Jesucristo tukꞌ u Kubꞌaal Tiixheꞌ. As kat toksa Aak u chiibꞌichileꞌ tu u qaanxelaleꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌl iyaꞌtebꞌal. As tiꞌ vibꞌaꞌnil Aakeꞌ ootzimal sqaꞌn uvaꞌ la ibꞌan Aak kam uvaꞌ alel kan sqiꞌ taꞌn Aak.
As Aakeꞌ la yakꞌinsan etaama. As Aakeꞌ la lochon ex tiꞌ ebꞌanat u bꞌaꞌneꞌ as tiꞌ etalataꞌ.
